info.name: Brevo Email API - Smart Battery Calculator
info.description: Minimal Brevo HTTPS API checks for the Smart Battery Calculator. Set brevoApiKey, senderEmail and recipientEmail in Postman. No real secrets are included.

exec: pm.test('Brevo API key accepted', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Configured sender is active', function () { const b=pm.response.json(); const target=(pm.collectionVariables.get('senderEmail')||'').toLowerCase(); const sender=(b.senders||[]).find(s => (s.email||'').toLowerCase()===target); pm.expect(sender, 'sender must exist').to.exist; pm.expect(sender.active, 'sender must be active/verified').to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Email accepted by Brevo', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
